power.answer: China Eastern allows each passenger no more than two power banks, carried in the cabin and never in the overhead compartment. A power bank must stay off for the whole flight and may not charge a device or be charged on board.

sections.h: 🔋 What China Eastern says about power banks
sections.p: From the China Eastern General Conditions for Transportation of Passengers and Baggage (July 2026), sections 5.4.2.4 and 7.2.1.3, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
China Eastern rule
rows: No more than two power banks per passenger
Power banks must not be stored there
Power banks are listed as items for carry-on only, not checked baggage
On board, from boarding until everyone has left
No using it to charge devices and no charging the power bank itself
Power banks must be kept off at all times on board

list: Not on the page: the sections read give no Wh limit for power banks; the spare battery rule in the same document is one battery of 300 Wh or two of 160 Wh, for mobility aids.

faq: How many power banks can I take on China Eastern?
No more than two per passenger.
Can I use a power bank on China Eastern?
No. Charging devices from it or charging the power bank itself is not allowed from boarding until all passengers have left the aircraft, and it must stay off.
sources: China Eastern — General Conditions for Transportation of Passengers and Baggage (July 2026)
